alignments.reason: Includes both constructing the required fractional measurement display and solving contextual addition/subtraction questions with like-denominator amounts in halves, quarters, or eighths.

label: 4.MD.B.4
meaning: Practice covers aligned canonical concepts, with no claim of complete standard coverage or mastery.

sourceNode.description: Make a line plot to display a data set of measurements in fractions of a unit (1/2, 1/4, 1/8). Solve problems involving addition and subtraction of fractions by using information presented in line plots . For example, from a line plot find and interpret the difference in length between the longest and shortest specimens in an insect collection.
